translations.web: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
translations.bsb: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
translations.kjv: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
translations.asv: And now ye know that which restraineth, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
